# DAViewer v0.5.20

## 本次更新

- 当 DeviantArt 拦截当前网络或代理时，改为给出明确提示，可按提示稍后再试或更换节点，不再静默反复请求。
- 推荐加载失败时显示的原因更准确，不再把网页会话问题误报为接口故障。
- 登录状态的恢复过程记录更完整，出现异常时更容易定位。

## What's New

- When DeviantArt blocks the current network or proxy, the app now says so clearly instead of retrying silently, so you can wait or switch nodes.
- When recommendations fail, the reason shown is now accurate instead of blaming the wrong service.
- Sign-in state recovery is recorded more completely, making session problems easier to diagnose.
